about: An underground cavern exploration in the Zork tradition. It starts in a barrow, with a lantern and sword, and leads through caves, a ravine, a ford and a disorienting carousel room.

done.why: Within a few minutes I hit three blocked paths in a row (rockfall, crumbling ledge, a wall). Nothing gave me a goal or a puzzle to chew on, so I quit.

moments.note: Walking south into the dark tunnel gave a grue warning, then the lamp fixed it. Familiar and fun.
The ledge crumbled and I was told to wait. That was another blocked path, and I quit.

wished: A clear goal or hint of what to do
Something to interact with beyond walking
A way past the blocked passages

lines.line: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
lines.why: A familiar nod that worked as a hook.

lines.line: The way up has gone, for now. Whatever is along there will have to wait.
lines.why: The world turned me away politely, but I still had nowhere to go.

fun.why: It was pleasant to walk through, but I had nothing to do.

engagement.why: There was no goal and several dead ends, so I lost interest quickly.

difficulty.why: The puzzles weren't hard, but I never found any. Progress was just blocked.

interestingness.why: The setting is familiar. The carousel room and the ford were nice touches.

prose.why: The room descriptions are clean and atmospheric.
